components.name: Primary action
components.description: Storefront action with an inset arrow well.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:50px;padding:10px 11px 10px 24px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:50px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;font-family:var(--font-body, Outfit, sans-serif);transition:background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);cursor:pointer;background:var(--ink, #492b22);color:var(--paper, #faf6ed)}.ds-primary>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff17;transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--brown-dark, #332017)}.ds-primary:hover>span{transform:rotate(9deg)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose, #a64d50);outline-offset:5px}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-primary>span{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Outlined commerce action with blush hover.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:50px;padding:10px 11px 10px 24px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:50px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;font-family:var(--font-body, Outfit, sans-serif);transition:background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #492b22);border-color:var(--line, #dfd4c5)}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--blush, #f2d6cf);border-color:var(--blush, #f2d6cf)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose, #a64d50);outline-offset:5px}.ds-secondary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-secondary:disabled{background:#e0d7cc;color:var(--muted, #725749);border-color:transparent;opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.name: Text action
components.description: Underlined supporting action with diagonal arrow feedback.
components.html: Our story
components.css: .ds-text{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:8px 0;font-family:var(--font-body, Outfit, sans-serif);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink, #492b22);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor}.ds-text svg{transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)}.ds-text:hover svg{transform:translate(2px,-2px)}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose, #a64d50);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-text svg{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font-family:var(--font-body, Outfit, sans-serif);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink, #492b22)}.ds-field{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:48px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid var(--line, #dfd4c5);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface, #fffdf8);padding:12px 14px;color:var(--ink, #492b22);font-family:var(--font-body, Outfit, sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:400;caret-color:var(--rose, #a64d50)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #725749);opacity:1}.ds-field:focus{border-color:var(--rose, #a64d50)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose, #a64d50);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Desktop links underline on hover and at the current destination; phones use the separate menu panel.
components.html: The menuOur storyYour cookie storiesSay hello
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:16px;background:var(--paper, #faf6ed);color:var(--ink, #492b22);font-family:var(--font-body, Outfit, sans-serif);font-size:13px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:8px 0;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:4px;height:1px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a[aria-current]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose, #a64d50);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a::after{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.name: Filter chip
components.description: Outlined menu/review filter; aria-pressed captures selection.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">With photos</button><button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Everything</button>
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 17px;border:1px solid var(--line, #dfd4c5);border-radius:50px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #492b22);font-family:var(--font-body, Outfit, sans-serif);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)}.ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink, #492b22);border-color:var(--ink, #492b22);color:var(--paper, #faf6ed)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose, #a64d50);outline-offset:5px}.ds-chip:active{transform:scale(.98)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chip{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.css: .ds-seal{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;width:116px;height:116px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blush, #f2d6cf);color:var(--ink, #492b22);box-shadow:0 7px 20px #492b2212;transform:rotate(12deg);cursor:pointer;transition:background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)}.ds-seal>span{font-family:var(--font-display, Ahsing, Georgia, serif);font-size:20px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.05}.ds-seal:hover{transform:rotate(0)}.ds-seal:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose, #a64d50);outline-offset:5px}.ds-seal:active{transform:scale(.98)}@media(max-width:1050px){.ds-seal{width:93px;height:93px}.ds-seal>span{font-size:17px}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-seal{width:88px;height:88px;gap:2px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-seal{transition:none;animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, chocolate lettering and real bakery photography create a generous, inviting shop window. The supplied Ahsing display face supplies the personality; Outfit makes browsing, ordering and staff work clear. Blush and rose introduce restrained confectionery color without competing with the food.

Expressive headings and product imagery carry the storefront. The same palette becomes quieter in forms, checkout and administration: labeled controls, explicit selection, tonal panels and direct feedback. This direction was established under the user's delegated visual judgment; it is the implemented visual system, not a separate proposed identity.
keyCharacteristics: Expressive Ahsing headings with calm Outfit interface text.
Warm continuous paper, chocolate ink and restrained blush and rose accents.
Real product photography, generous section rhythm and compact rounded surfaces.
Clear ordering controls, visible keyboard focus and brief, optional motion.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the page ground continuous; use tonal panels or warm boundaries where a task needs grouping.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Reserve Ahsing for display headings and wordmarks; use Outfit for controls and information that must scan quickly.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Keep product and ordinary content surfaces flat; reserve prominent elevation for overlays and transient feedback.

dos: **Do** use actual catalog photography, prices and stored customer submissions.
**Do** preserve the warm paper ground, the final muted text token and the Ahsing/Outfit role split.
**Do** keep ordering choices explicit, labeled and visibly selected.
**Do** preserve keyboard focus, browser zoom, reduced motion and complete loading, empty, failure and retry states.
**Do** verify review deployment permissions and cloud behavior using `REVIEWS_SETUP.md` before production launch.
donts: **Don't** invent ratings, endorsements, sales counts or verified-purchase claims.
**Don't** restore decorative polka dots, repeated waves or blocking loading intros from the superseded visual treatment.
**Don't** put Ahsing on dense controls or add shadows to ordinary product cards.
**Don't** hide content until an animation runs or add continuous decorative rotation.
**Don't** treat a local UI check as proof that cloud review submission or staff publishing is deployed.
